en.title: Asset Analysis
en.stamp: As of Wednesday, September 30, 2026. A fast rise in the 10 year yield and widening high yield spreads set the tone.
en.banner: The 10 year nominal yield climbed to **5.24%** from **4.96%** over five observations while the high yield spread widened to **308** bp from **273** bp, and that tightening of financial conditions is doing the work on the tape. Real yields at **2.90%** are rising alongside a dollar index of **101.45**, which pressures gold and crypto, while cash earns a real **1.83%** and the S&P 500 sits only **1.6%** below its 52 week high.

assets.name: US Stocks
assets.one: Rising long yields and widening credit spreads squeeze equities, but the index is holding near its highs with volatility low.
assets.qual: bottoming, the downside is being absorbed as the index sits 1.6% below its high with VIX near 16

factors.b: The high yield spread widened to **308** bp from **273** bp over five observations.
The 10 year nominal yield rose to **5.24%** from **4.96%** across the last five observations.
The VIX stands at **15.89**, near the low end of its recent range.

assets.name: US Cash
assets.one: Cash pays a solid real return with the policy rate held flat, though the risk on tape blunts its appeal.
assets.qual: held policy and positive real carry make cash a clean carry, capped only by strong risk appetite elsewhere

factors.b: The fed funds effective rate has held at **3.88%** across the last five observations.
Real carry against core CPI stands at **1.83%**.
The S&P 500 sits just **1.6%** below its 52 week high.

assets.name: Gold
assets.one: Rising real yields, a firm dollar, and a price below its 200 day average all press gold lower.
assets.qual: no offset in sight, real yields and the dollar are both moving against the metal while it trades below trend

factors.b: The 10 year real yield rose to **2.90%** from **2.63%** over five observations.
The dollar index at **101.45** stands **2.2%** above its 200 day average.
The 10 year breakeven held steady at **2.35%** across the last five observations.

assets.name: Crypto
assets.one: Rising real yields, a strong dollar, and widening spreads weigh on crypto, but bitcoin holds well above its moving averages.
assets.qual: bottoming, the downside is being absorbed with bitcoin still 8.4% above its 50 day average

factors.b: The 10 year real yield climbed to **2.90%** from **2.63%** over five observations.
The dollar index stands at **101.45**, which is **2.2%** above its 200 day average.
Bitcoin at **83,785** dollars trades **8.4%** above its 50 day average.

tiles.read: At 2.90% and rising fast, the real yield is the single biggest drag on non yielding assets right now.
The 5.24% nominal yield has climbed sharply in five observations and is tightening financial conditions for equities.
Breakevens steady at 2.35% say inflation expectations are anchored, offering gold no fresh fuel.
The spread at 308 bp has widened from 273 bp, a clear sign of growing credit caution.
The 3 month T bill at 4.28% keeps short term cash well paid even as the policy rate holds.
The effective rate holding at 3.88% signals a steady policy stance rather than an easing one.
A VIX near 15.89 shows equity fear is absent even as yields rise.
At 7,696 the index is only 1.6% below its high, so the downside is being absorbed rather than breaking.
Bitcoin at 83,785 dollars slipped 0.3% over five sessions but remains well above its key averages.

tiles.src: Yahoo Finance, COMEX front month, September 30
tiles.read: Gold at 4,185 dollars fell 3.1% over five sessions and trades below its 200 day average.
A dollar index at 101.45 and above its 200 day average is a headwind for gold and crypto alike.

zh.title: 资产分析
zh.stamp: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，星期三。 10 年期收益率快速上行叠加高收益利差走阔，定下今日基调。
zh.banner: 10 年期名义收益率在五次观测中从 **4.96%** 升至 **5.24%**，高收益利差从 **273** 个基点走阔至 **308** 个基点，金融环境的收紧正在主导盘面。实际利率升至 **2.90%**，美元指数为 **101.45**，两者同步上行对黄金和加密资产构成压力，而现金的实际回报为 **1.83%**，标普 500 仅比 52 周高点低 **1.6%**。

assets.name: 美股
assets.one: 长端收益率上行叠加信用利差走阔对股票构成挤压，但指数仍坚守高位附近，波动率处于低位。
assets.qual: 筑底中，指数距高点仅 1.6%，VIX 接近 16，下行压力正在被吸收

factors.b: 高收益利差在五次观测中从 **273** 个基点走阔至 **308** 个基点。
10 年期名义收益率在过去五次观测中从 **4.96%** 升至 **5.24%**。
VIX 目前为 **15.89**，处于近期区间的低端附近。

assets.name: 美元现金
assets.one: 政策利率持稳之下现金提供扎实的实际回报，但风险偏好的升温削弱了其吸引力。
assets.qual: 政策按兵不动叠加正的实际利差使现金成为干净的套息选择，唯一制约是其他资产的强劲风险偏好

factors.h: 联邦基金利率水平与倾向
factors.b: 联邦基金有效利率在过去五次观测中一直维持在 **3.88%**。
相对核心 CPI 的实际利差为 **1.83%**。

assets.name: 黄金
assets.one: 实际利率上行、美元走强以及价格低于 200 日均线，共同压制黄金。
assets.qual: 看不到反向因素，实际利率和美元都在与黄金作对，价格又运行在趋势线之下

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率在五次观测中从 **2.63%** 升至 **2.90%**。
10 年期盈亏平衡通胀在过去五次观测中稳定在 **2.35%**。

assets.name: 加密资产
assets.one: 实际利率上行、美元走强和利差走阔拖累加密资产，但比特币仍远高于其均线。
assets.qual: 筑底中，比特币仍高出 50 日均线 8.4%，下行压力正在被吸收

factors.b: 10 年期实际利率在五次观测中从 **2.63%** 升至 **2.90%**。

tiles.read: 实际利率处于 2.90% 且快速上行，是当前无息资产最大的单一拖累。
5.24% 的名义收益率在五次观测中大幅攀升，正在收紧股票面临的金融环境。
盈亏平衡通胀稳定在 2.35%，表明通胀预期已被锚定，无法为黄金提供新的动力。
利差为 308 个基点，自 273 个基点走阔，是信用谨慎情绪升温的明确信号。
3 个月期国库券收益率为 4.28%，即便政策利率按兵不动，短期现金仍回报可观。
有效利率维持在 3.88%，表明政策立场稳定而非宽松。
VIX 接近 15.89，说明即便收益率上行，股票市场的恐慌情绪并不存在。
指数报 7,696 点，仅比高点低 1.6%，下行压力正在被吸收而非破位。
